name: minisketch-ai-tools
description: MiniSketch CAD tool manifest. Single source of truth for the AI chat tab, the ai-bridge server, and future MCP wrappers. Names use snake_case; the chat executor maps each to the camelCase toolApi() function in app.js. Units are world millimetres, Y-DOWN (screen/SVG/CNC convention: +X right, +Y down, so 'above' is a smaller/negative Y). Coordinates are clamped to +/-10000.

colorLegend.#000000: Cut through (black) — the ONLY color for shapes the part keeps as separate pieces; drilled holes are black circles too. Follows the path, so open paths are allowed
colorLegend.#0000ff: Engrave (blue) — AREA operation: the geometry MUST be a closed loop (an open blue path cannot be engraved)
colorLegend.#800080: Pocket (purple) — AREA operation: the boundary MUST be closed
colorLegend.#ff0000: Marking line (red) — LOW POWER: scores the surface, does NOT cut through; never for outlines or holes. Follows the path, so open paths are allowed

function.name: add_line
function.description: Draw one straight cut line between two world points. Points at exactly the same spot are welded into one joint.

color.description: Hex operation color, defaults to current UI color

function.name: add_circle
function.description: Draw a circle from center point and radius in mm. COLOR RULE: a drilled hole (lubang/bor/hole) is a THROUGH cut, so it MUST be #000000 (black). Red #ff0000 is a low-power marking line only — never for holes or cut shapes.

function.name: add_arc
function.description: Draw an arc from centre point and two points ON the arc (start and end).

function.name: add_spline
function.description: Draw a smooth Bezier curve through 2+ points. Use for slots, ovals, S-curves, ogee edges, fillets — any smooth outline. closed=true makes a closed loop panel. COLOR RULE follows the operation: cut-out loop = #000000, engraved mark = #0000ff, pocket boundary = #800080.

function.name: add_panel
function.description: Draw a closed sharp-corner polygon panel (rectangle, flange plate, bracket outline). Minimum 3 points. This is the tool for boxes, plates and any straight-edge closed shape. COLOR RULE: a shape to CUT OUT uses #000000 (black = CUT through); red #ff0000 is marking-only (low power, never through); construction = #00ff00.

function.name: add_polyline
function.description: Draw an open sharp-corner polyline. Use for kerf slits (through = #000000), surface score/marking lines (#ff0000), and construction guides (#00ff00, never machined). Minimum 2 points.

function.name: add_note
function.description: Place a yellow non-machined workshop comment (also used as copy-count number inside a part or green sheet for Nesting). NEVER use for visible lettering on the finished part — use add_text for that.

function.name: add_text
function.description: Place real TEXT whose glyph outlines are cuttable geometry (house numbers, labels, signs). COLOR RULE: text to cut through = #000000 (black); engraved look = #0000ff; red #ff0000 only for a low-power surface marking of the text. Set height in mm (default: last used). Use add_note only for non-machined annotations.

fill.description: Optional KaryaCNC fill mode (outline fonts only): none, gray (material boundary/flip inside), yellow (flip offset direction)

function.name: add_constraint
function.description: Add a parametric constraint. Entity/point ids come from the state summary (selected: [...]). Omit value for coincident/horizontal/vertical/midpoint/tangent/parallel/perpendicular/equal/anchor; give value in mm or degrees for distance/radius/angle/dimension.

entity.description: Entity id the constraint acts on

entity2.description: Second entity id (parallel, perpendicular, equal, angle)

value.description: mm for distance/radius/pointDim, degrees for angle

function.name: move_selection
function.description: Move the current selection by dx, dy millimetres.

function.name: scale_selection
function.description: Scale the current selection by sx, sy about origin point ox, oy (defaults to selection centre when omitted).

function.name: rotate_selection
function.description: Rotate the current selection by angle degrees (+ = clockwise in Y-down/SVG, - = counter-clockwise) about pivot ox, oy (defaults to selection centre when omitted).

angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees (+ clockwise, - counter-clockwise)

ox.description: Optional pivot X in mm (defaults to selection centre)

oy.description: Optional pivot Y in mm (defaults to selection centre)

function.name: mirror_selection
function.description: Mirror (flip) the current selection across axis 'x' (horizontal left-right flip) or 'y' (vertical top-bottom flip) about pivot ox, oy (defaults to selection centre when omitted).

axis.description: 'x' flips left-right across vertical line x=ox; 'y' flips top-bottom across horizontal line y=oy

ox.description: Optional mirror pivot X in mm (defaults to selection centre)

oy.description: Optional mirror pivot Y in mm (defaults to selection centre)

function.name: duplicate_selection
function.description: Duplicate the current selection in the same undo step, select the new copy, and optionally shift it by dx, dy mm.

dx.description: Optional horizontal offset in mm for the duplicate (default 0)

dy.description: Optional vertical offset in mm for the duplicate (default 0)

function.name: set_selection_color
function.description: Set KaryaCNC stroke color and/or fill mode on the current selection (curves/loops, text, groups/art). Overrides all contours uniformly inside groups. Arrays/clones are read-only and always inherit from their master. Pass color and/or fill.

fill.description: Optional KaryaCNC fill mode: none (clear), gray (material boundary — flips everything inside), yellow (flip offset direction of contour)

function.name: set_default_color
function.description: Set the drawing color for subsequently created geometry.

function.name: remove_entity
function.description: Delete one entity by id. Destructive: the chat tab asks for confirmation first.

function.name: delete_selection
function.description: Delete everything currently selected. Destructive: the chat tab asks for confirmation first.

function.name: clear_selection
function.description: Deselect everything.

function.name: group_selection
function.description: Group the current selection into one named object (bake). Pass a name so double-click can re-edit it.

function.name: call_generator
function.description: Run a parametric generator. Must be the ONLY op in its turn (generators manage their own undo step). Params are the generator dialog fields: box {l,w,h,t,fw,lid,dim}, gear {teeth,module_mm,...}, slot {length,width,...}, wall {length,height,...}, hinge/slidetop/pulltop (their dialog fields).

function.name: set_selection
function.description: Select specific entities by id (from get_entities / get_selection / earlier op results). The next ops (boolean, text_to_curves, ungroup, offset, move, color, delete) act on this selection.

function.name: text_to_curves
function.description: Convert the selected TEXT object into individual curve outlines (one per glyph contour), deleting the text object. THE stencil step: after this, every letter part can be booleans/moved/deleted separately. Needs the text selected (set_selection or user selection).

id.description: Optional text entity id; omit to use current selection

function.name: ungroup
function.description: Break the selection apart: a group loses its tag; a text/art object converts to raw curves (same as text_to_curves).

function.name: boolean
function.description: Boolean op on selected closed loops: union (merge all), cut (last selected loop punches through the first), intersect (keep only overlap). ORDER MATTERS for cut: select the TARGET loop FIRST, then the TOOL (cutter) loop LAST — e.g. set_selection [target, tool].

function.name: offset_selection
function.description: Offset the selected closed loops by distance mm (positive grows, negative shrinks) into NEW panel entities. Use for stencil bridges, kerf compensation, inlay sockets, border rings.

function.name: get_entities
function.description: Query: list up to 100 entities with id, type, color and text content. Use to find the id of a text object before text_to_curves.

function.name: get_svg
function.description: Query: return the drawing as SVG markup. Prefer this over get_entities when you need to understand shape, position, size or nesting: you read SVG natively. Coordinates are Y-down world millimetres, 1:1 with the world frame (nothing mirrored), and every path carries the CNC operation colour as its stroke (see colorLegend). Use scope='selection' to get only what is currently selected and 'all' (default) for the whole document. Large drawings are capped at 60k characters and flagged with truncated=true.

scope.description: 'all' (default) exports every visible entity; 'selection' exports only the current selection.

includeHidden.description: Also export entities on hidden layers. Defaults to false.

function.name: import_svg
function.description: Create: insert a complete SVG drawing into the workspace as real vector entities (lines, splines, circles). This is the PREFERRED way to build anything with more than ~4 paths: write one SVG document (paths, circles, rects, lines) instead of many add_line/add_circle calls — far fewer tokens and one undo step. Coordinates: world millimetres, Y-down — an SVG is already in that frame, so write it normally and it lands unmirrored. Place with viewBox='0 0 W H' so 1 user unit = 1 mm; a plain width/height in mm also works. Stroke colours become the entity colours — use the colorLegend hex codes so the result is machinable. Fill attributes are decoration; outlines are what get imported.

svg.description: Complete SVG document text (starts with <svg ...>). Max ~150k characters.

at.description: World point where the centre of the drawing lands. Omit to centre on the canvas.

scale.description: Extra scale multiplier on top of the viewBox/width mapping. Default 1.

yUp.description: false (default): the SVG is Y-down, the same frame as the world, and is imported 1:1 — never flip coordinates yourself. Set true ONLY when the source was authored Y-up (origin bottom-left, +Y up — some CAD/plotter exports); the importer then mirrors it into the Y-down world. An SVG you got from get_svg is Y-down, so leave this false.

keepGroups.description: true = each <g id=...> becomes one grouped object. Default false (flat entities).

function.name: get_bounds
function.description: Query: world bounding box of all geometry, plus canvas centre in world mm. Use to place new shapes relative to existing ones (e.g. a hole in the middle).

function.name: get_loops
function.description: Query: closed machinable loops with area and entity count. Use to verify a shape really closed.

function.name: describe_selection
function.description: Query: rich detail of the USER'S CURRENT selection — per entity: id, type, color, text content, world bbox, and loop analysis (which loops are outer rings vs enclosed counters, loop areas). Call this FIRST whenever the user says 'the selected X' / 'yang saya pilih' before any boolean or edit.

function.name: use_skill
function.description: Force-load a named skill for this turn (available: stencil-bridges). Use when the user names a technique explicitly, or when the request clearly matches a skill whose trigger words did not appear in their message.
